# Ditching Peter

> ARA (Authority, Responsibility, Ability) is a way to write a role so an organisation knows who may decide, what must be delivered, and what the job requires.

ARA uses three keywords. MAY and MAY NOT are Authority: the decision, the limit, and who it escalates to. MUST is Responsibility: the deliverable, who receives it, and when. CAN is Ability: the named skill, tool, or method. Money limits in the published specs are examples. Set your own.

Nine roles are free, in full, on the role library and in roles.json. The other eighteen are sold in a one-off pack and their specs are not published on this site. The pack is all 27 roles, 7 team structures with reporting and escalation charts, editable DOCX and Markdown files, a 77-page PDF, and JSON and AGENTS.md versions for agent builders. Future updates are included. Prices rise as the library grows.

Launch prices hold until 28 October 2026. After that the standard prices are £29 for an individual, £99 for a team of up to 25 people, and £249 for a commercial licence.

## Role library

- [Role library](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library): Nine free ARA specs, and a one-line listing of the eighteen roles in the pack
- [roles.json](https://ditchingpeter.com/roles.json): The nine free specs in full. Paid roles are title, one line, and in_pack true, with no spec content
- [Sales Director](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#sales-director): Reports to the CEO. Contract, discount, budget, and hiring authority for the sales team
- [Sales Executive](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#sales-executive): Reports to the Sales Director. Also called Account Executive or Business Development Manager
- [Customer Success Manager](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#customer-success-manager): Reports to the Head of Customer Success. Onboarding, health scores, credits, and renewals
- [Product Manager](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#product-manager): Reports to the Product Director. What ships next, inside the agreed roadmap
- [Project Manager](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#project-manager): Reports to the Head of Delivery. Runs a project inside the agreed scope, dates, and budget
- [Engineering Manager](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#engineering-manager): Reports to the Head of Engineering. Team standards, delivery health, and on-call cover
- [Software Engineer](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#software-engineer): Reports to the Engineering Manager. Tested, reviewed code for assigned tickets
- [HR Business Partner](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#hr-business-partner): Reports to the CEO, or to a Head of People where that role exists
- [Marketing Manager](https://ditchingpeter.com/role-library#marketing-manager): Reports to the CEO. Approved budget, qualified leads, and the marketing plan

## Full library

- [Individual licence — £29, launch price £19 until 28 October 2026](https://payhip.com/b/RGbfI): One person. The pack includes JSON and AGENTS.md versions for agent builders
- [Team licence, up to 25 people — £99, launch price £69 until 28 October 2026](https://payhip.com/b/6LkoT): One purchase for a team of up to 25. The pack includes JSON and AGENTS.md versions for agent builders

## The framework

- [Home](https://ditchingpeter.com/): What ARA is, and where the library is sold
- [Getting started](https://ditchingpeter.com/getting-started): Every role defined as a spec — MAY, MUST, and CAN
- [Format](https://ditchingpeter.com/format): How to write a MAY, a MUST, and a CAN
- [Prompting AI](https://ditchingpeter.com/prompting-ai): Give an assistant standing authority, ongoing responsibilities, and named abilities
- [About](https://ditchingpeter.com/about): Christian Macedo, who wrote Ditching Peter
- [Blog](https://ditchingpeter.com/blog): Notes on roles and organisational health
- [We took a real Chief of Staff spec and found the bug](https://ditchingpeter.com/blog/chief-of-staff-teardown): A job description sorted into Authority, Responsibility, and Ability
